# Vision

widget builds a bill of materials from a parts list.

## Purpose

widget exists so a maker can price a build before buying a part.

## Serves

Makers who keep their parts in a TOML file and want one priced list.

## Owns

Turning a parts file into a priced bill, and nothing past the bill.

## Non-goals

- It does not order parts.
- It does not track stock.

## Direction

- Prices come from more than one supplier.

## Constraints

- The bill builds offline from the parts file alone.
